summary: transformers and huggingface_hub were removed from the Python 3.12.10 site-packages by a process outside this session, between the completed T13.17 scicomp replay (started 16:15, transformers 5.16.1 importable throughout) and the first phase-2 launch (18:27, ModuleNotFoundError). No pip command was issued by this session prior to the failure. Orphaned '~'-prefixed pip temp remnants (safetensors, tokenizers, numpy, huggingface_hub 1.21.0) indicate an interrupted external package operation. T13 evidence, frozen suites, engine freeze and all repo artifacts were unaffected.
